verdict.rationale: Omnara documents per-action approval gates and agents pausing to ask questions. That is an adjacent control, not a step where an engineering lead approves a task's scope or contract before any repository modification. Nothing in the evidence describes spec/scope review or a contract sign-off gate tied to repo writes.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can approve a task's scope and contract before an agent is allowed to modify the repository
